title: Kirak MCP server
description: One MCP server, defined in a JSON file in the project's mcp/ directory. With "mcp" in kirak.json modules, Kirak serves it at /mcp/<name>/ over Streamable HTTP; any MCP client can connect and sees only the tools listed here (plus Python tools registered with @kirak.mcp("<name>").tool).

$schema.description: Points editors at this schema. Kirak ignores it when loading.

name.description: The server's name: its URL (/mcp/<name>/) and how code and monitoring refer to it. Unique across mcp/.

x-kirak-errors.pattern: 'name' must be lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.

description.description: What the server is for, shown to clients as the server's description.

instructions.description: Guidance sent to the client when it connects, for the model using the tools. Not enforced.

access.description: Who may connect: Guest (anyone), User (any signed-in caller), Admin (role admin), System (system). Default User. Every tool call still runs as the caller, under the models' access rules.

roles.description: Only callers with one of these roles may connect, checked after access (e.g. ["support", "admin"]). Default: any role access allows.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Requests per minute per caller (per client IP for guests). Default 60.

tools.description: The Kirak operations this server offers as tools, keyed by ref. Default {}.
